Rolex · ref. 336933

Sky-Dweller

Travel watch with annual calendar · 42mm · 100m · automatic

The Sky-Dweller is one of Rolex's most complex models, designed for world travelers. It is defined by its dual time zone display and an annual calendar, indicated by a rotating off-center disc and apertures at each hour marker, all controlled by the rotatable 'Ring Command' bezel.

The story

Introduced in 2012, the Sky-Dweller was the first entirely new model from the brand in two decades. Initially available only in precious metals like gold, the collection expanded in 2017 with the introduction of more accessible 'Rolesor' versions, which combine Oystersteel and gold. A significant update occurred in 2023 with the introduction of the caliber 9002 movement, which succeeded the original caliber 9001, and the release of new reference numbers.
